viś. adv. by Rāmānujācārya of Cannupāḍi. Mysore I. p. 464. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 11.

Ubhayakavi
a Tārkika, 4th ancestor of Mallikārjuna alias Sphuliṅgakavi (Satyabhāmāpariṇaya). Ref. MT. 2168.

Ubhayagrahaṇavyavasthādhikāra

Ubhayagrāsa(grasta)rāhūdaya
by Vijayīndra Tīrtha. Believed to be a. allegorical drama written a. a counterblast to the Prabodhacandrodaya an. Saṁkalpasūryodaya. See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. II. p. 189. Oppert I. 2504 is probably same.
